name: Kojetice (Czechia)
description: Three vertical stripes of black, yellow and black at the hoist, together one quarter of the flag's length, and two equal horizontal stripes of yellow over red in the fly.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 22 November 2001 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
